name: app-problem-slide-four-soft-cards-with-glowing-pink-node
title: Four Problem Cards with a Central Pink Node
whatItIs: A white slide with a lime Problem pill, a large headline 'Travel Planning Is Painfully Fragmented', a side paragraph and a 2-by-2 grid of soft cards with faint numerals 01 to 04 and problem titles and descriptions, joined by a glowing pink node with cross rays at the centre.
whatItMeans: Very faint cards and one pink node make four problems feel like parts of one issue, and the lime pill is the only bright colour.
techniques: Ghost numerals at the top of each card
Pink glowing node with rays at the grid centre
Lime pill for the section label
Text anchored to the card base

vocabulary.definition: A very faint number marking an item.
A glowing dot linking a grid of items.
A slide listing the issues a project addresses.
